Attractor: Strange attractor that the points follow: lorenz, aizawa, thomas, halvorsen or dadras.
Attractorb: Second attractor, followed by the share of points set by Morph.
Morph: Share of points (0-1) that follow Attractor B instead of A. 0 = all A.
Play: On: advect points each frame. Off: hold the current state.
Reset: Pulse: recapture the points from in1 and restart (with Preroll).
Fieldscale: Size of the attractor in world units. Points are mapped to attractor space by (P - Center) / Field Size.
Centerx: X of the attractor centre in world units.
Centery: Y of the attractor centre in world units.
Centerz: Z of the attractor centre in world units.
Coefmod: Amount the attractor coefficients wobble over time. 0 = fixed attractor.
Coefspeed: Rate of the coefficient wobble in radians per second.
Substeps: Integration steps per frame. More = more accurate but slower.
Rebirth: Fraction of points sent back to their source position each frame. 0 = none.
Seed: Random seed for rebirth selection and the demo scatter.
Preroll: Frames of flow applied when the state is (re)initialised, so points start on the attractor.
Trails: On: out1 becomes polylines showing recent history. Off: plain points.
Traillength: Length of the trails in seconds of history. Used when Trails is on.
Demoshape: Shape of the demo point cloud used when in1 is unconnected: sphere or box.
Demopoints: Number of demo points when in1 is unconnected.
Colormix: How much the speed-based colour overwrites the Color attribute. 0 = keep input colour.
Colorspeed: Speed that maps to Color Fast. Higher values make more points look slow.
Pointsize: Preview only: point size in pixels.
